claims: As of March 24, 2026, the Chicago Cubs and outfielder Pete Crow-Armstrong are finalizing a long-term contract extension.
The long-term contract extension is reported to be worth over $100 million.
Pete Crow-Armstrong is an All-Star center fielder.
Pete Crow-Armstrong achieved a 30-30-30 season in 2025.
Pete Crow-Armstrong won a Gold Glove in 2025.
The deal secures Pete Crow-Armstrong through his pre-arbitration years.
Pete Crow-Armstrong was not slated for free agency until 2030.
The Chicago Cubs made a previous rejected offer to Pete Crow-Armstrong.
Pete Crow-Armstrong was traded from the Mets in 2021.
Pete Crow-Armstrong previously played on his rookie salary
